findings.description: JWT token replay if refresh token compromised

Spoofing.rationale: JWT-based auth; spoofing requires token compromise

Tampering.rationale: Prisma ORM + Zod validation provide integrity; clinicGuard enforces tenant isolation

Repudiation.rationale: Winston logging + audit trail in LGPD module provide non-repudiation

findings.description: Administration & Identity data leak via misconfigured access control

Denial of Service.rationale: Express-rate-limit present; nginx rate limiting configured

Elevation of Privilege.rationale: RBAC with role checks; admin_tools restricted to ADMIN role
